title: Ebbibiro Erimenye Obwakabaka
intro: Ensi ey’emigga egikulukuta, ensuku bbiri ezirabika obulungi, n’obugagga obutafaanana — naye abatuuze baayo ne batafaayo ku Oyo eyabawa omukisa. Ebijjukizo bwe byajja nga bibayita okuddayo, ne bakyuka. Ekyaddirira kyali kibonerezo ekikyawulikika ng’okulabula. Ekitundu kino eky’edda kyali ani?
clues: Twabeera mu nsi eyali ejjudde emikisa nnyo ne kiba nti amaka gaffe gaali wakati w’ensuku bbiri ezirabika obulungi.
Twanyumirwanga nnyo emigga egyali gikulukuta mu bibanja byaffe n’amakungula amangi nga gajjula amaka gaffe.
Naye bwe twayitibwa okugenda mu kwebaza n’okugondera Mukama waffe, twakyuka mu maanyi.
Obugagga bwaffe n’obwangu bwaffe byatuleetera okwerabira Oyo eyali abiwadde byonna.
Awo ne wajja omugga ogw’amangu ogwamenya ekiziyiza ekinene kye twali twesigamyeko.
Ffe tuli bantu ba Saba’, ettaka lyabwe eryamanyibwa olw’ebbibiro eddene erya Ma’rib.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
